title: Antiserum leftover packet v1
description: Optional leftover-review packet (`antiserum.leftover_packet.v1`). A subset of a confirm-loop store for flags left as needs_human. Digests, rationales, and optional proposed signatures only — never raw corpus text. Local CLI: `antiserum export-leftovers` / `antiserum import-decisions`. No live PoQ wire. Decision import stays judgments.schema.json.

dataset_hash.description: Same identity field as the scan receipt / judgment store (typically `sha256:` + hex).

scanner_version.description: Package version that produced the flags (`receipt.version` / judgment-store `scanner_version`).

exported_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp, preferably ending in Z

exporter.description: Optional tool or operator label. Not a network endpoint.

pack.description: Optional local feed identity. Path + hash only; not the signature lines.

path.description: Local feed path, or `none` when no feed was found.

hash.description: sha256 of the local feed file, or `none`.

leftover.description: Known keys only. Raw corpus fields (`text`, `label`, `content`, `instruction`, `input`, `output`, `messages`, `conversations`, `prompt`, `completion`) are not properties and are rejected.

decision.description: needs_human is expected on a first export. poison, junk, and false_alarm are allowed if the packet is re-exported after confirm.

example_hashes.description: sha256 hex digests of normalized example texts (with or without a `sha256:` prefix). Digests only — never raw corpus text.

proposed_signature.description: Same shape as judgments.schema.json `$defs/proposed_signature`. Optional on a leftover; present when a specific pattern is already drafted.
